paper_title: 文本样式和主题框架引导下的大模型辅助儿童新闻生成
caption_used: 该饼图展示了大模型辅助生成的儿童长新闻在各主题类别中的数量分布，共包含8个切片。从占比来看，社会类新闻占比最高，达到21%，其次为榜样类（19%）和文化类（20%）。科学类与环境保护类均为14%，政治类占6%，体育类占4%，经济类最低仅为2%。整体而言，社会与文化类新闻合计占据了总量的约41%，远超其他类别的总和，反映出儿童新闻内容在这两个领域的高度集中趋势。
model_annotation: The pie chart illustrates the distribution of children's long news generated by large model assistance across various topics. There are a total of 8 slices, each representing a different category. The largest slice is for the "榜样" (role models) category, accounting for 21%. The "文化" (culture) and "科学" (science) categories are equally represented at 20% each. The "社会" (society) category follows closely with 19%. Both "政治" (politics) and "环境保护" (environmental protection) have a share of 14%. The "体育" (sports) and "科学" (science) categories have smaller portions, at 6% and 4% respectively. Finally, the "经济" (economics) category has the smallest representation, comprising only 2% of the total.
